pk.context: 10 mg/kg intravenous, single dose, healthy adults

pill.desc: white or off-white lyophilized powder in a single-use vial

tell: A CTLA-4 fusion protein whose boxed warning covers post-transplant lymphoproliferative disorder, mainly in the CNS.

clues.text: Clearance tends to rise with body weight, while age, sex, race and renal function have no effect.
Produced by recombinant DNA technology in mammalian cells and supplied as a sterile lyophilized powder.
Approved under a BLA as 250 mg single-use vials, given by infusion once monthly.

Boxed warning for post-transplant lymphoproliferative disorder, other malignancies and serious infections; contraindicated in EBV seronegative patients. Anemia and diarrhea are the most common reactions.
Prophylaxis of organ rejection in adult patients receiving kidney transplants, used with basiliximab, mycophenolate mofetil and corticosteroids.
Binds CD80 and CD86 on antigen-presenting cells, blocking CD28-mediated costimulation of T lymphocytes.
The generic name begins with B and has ten letters.
